name: aprs_addr_status
meaning: APRS address parse status: 0 ok, 1 bad SSID, 2 long (7-9 char) callsign

name: aprs_path_hbit_done
meaning: H bit already given to a path element

name: frame_cur
meaning: cursor into the MAIN->SUB IPC frame payload / post_line12 slot

name: screen_substate
meaning: APRS detail screen sub-state (5 title, 8 rows)

name: row_ctx
meaning: row index passed to row builder callbacks

name: row_painter
meaning: function pointer of the active screen's row painter

name: list_sel
meaning: selection copied from FFB3F1/FFB3F5 for relative rows

name: aprs_work_rec
meaning: work copy of an APRS station/message record

name: aprs_rec_type
meaning: record +0x17 station-type index (NOT destination; contradicts doc 12)

name: aprs_rec_flags
meaning: record flags: b0 outgoing, b2 ack owed, b5 Emergency, b6 auto-reply, b7 acked

name: station_map
meaning: station list display order -> slot (FEE000 records)

name: msg_map
meaning: message list display order -> slot (FEE780 records)

name: dist_flags
meaning: b0 own S, b7 own W, b3 /10, b4 /20

name: setup_rd
meaning: USB SETUP ring read pointer (poll); L15 calls it the write pointer

name: setup_wr
meaning: USB SETUP ring write pointer (ISR); FF8158 is its low word

name: push_index
meaning: EP1 write index into FF5806 window

name: blk_left
meaning: bytes left in current 1 KB block

name: ipc_busy
meaning: IPC busy gate for block pushes

name: dsp_line
meaning: b7 handshake level, b0 edge event
